faqs.question: I’m not very tech-savvy. Is Voro easy for beginners to set up and use?

sections.content:
1. Click the "Download" button next to Voro in your NORVI dashboard to get the latest official installer (Voro_Setup.exe).
2. Run the installer and follow the quick on-screen instructions.
3. Once installation completes, launch Voro from your desktop shortcut or Windows Start Menu.
4. Voro will display the activation prompt upon first launch.
sections.heading: Download & Run Voro Installer

sections.content:
1. In your NORVI dashboard (https://nor-vi.in/account/agents), locate Voro in your active collection.
2. Click the "View License" button and copy your unique activation key (Format: NORVI-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-...).
3. Paste your key into the Voro activation window and click "Activate & Launch".
4. Once activated, Voro unlocks 100% unlimited, lifetime access with no recurring subscription fees or question caps.
sections.heading: Activate Your License Key

sections.content:
Voro runs high-speed AI models locally on your PC for maximum privacy and zero data leaks:
1. In Voro, open Settings (gear icon) and go to the "Help" tab -> "Quick Setup Guide".
2. Click "Download Ollama (Windows)" to download the official OllamaSetup.exe.
3. Run the installer to finish installing Ollama on your PC.
4. Launch Ollama once from your Start Menu (you can log in or simply skip).
5. Close or minimize Ollama — it will run quietly in your Windows system tray, and Voro will automatically connect to it!
sections.heading: Setup AI Brain

sections.content:
For near-instant voice transcription during live interviews, Groq provides lightning-fast Whisper processing for free:
1. In Voro Settings -> Help tab -> Quick Setup Guide, click "Get Free Groq API Key".
2. Sign up or log in to the Groq Console (100% free with Google or GitHub).
3. Click "Create API Key", set the Key Name to "VORO", and select "No Expiration".
4. Copy your generated key (starts with "gsk_...").
5. In Voro, go to the "Audio" tab, paste your key into the "Groq API Key" field, and click "Save & Restart".
sections.heading: Connect Groq Speech Recognition (<200ms)

sections.content:
Make Voro answer live interview questions using your real experience and projects:
1. In Voro Settings, open the "Profile" tab and paste your résumé, tech stack, and notable project achievements.
2. Open the "Company Info" tab and enter the company name and job description you are interviewing for.
3. Choose your preferred AI Tone in the "General" settings (e.g., "Conversational Script" or "Direct & Technical").
4. Click "Save & Restart" — Voro will now ground every answer in your real background!
sections.heading: Load Your Resume & Target Company Context

sections.content:
Follow these 4 essential rules before joining your live interview call:
• Rule 1 (Stealth Mode): Press Ctrl+Shift+G to enable Stealth Mode before sharing your screen. Voro will be 100% invisible to Zoom, Teams, Meet, and OBS!
• Rule 2 (System Audio Capture): Ensure the Headset icon (🎧) is green so Voro can hear the interviewer through your headphones.
• Rule 3 (Manual vs Auto Answering): Use Ctrl+Shift+U to toggle between Auto (⚡ Auto) and Manual (⏸️ Manual). In manual mode, press Ctrl+Enter to distill and answer the interviewer's question while filtering out small talk.
• Rule 4 (Occupancy Slider): Use the Occupancy slider on Voro's top bar to adjust window transparency to your preference.
